info.title: Hamstik Public API
info.description: Stable programmatic access to Hamstik through Personal Access Tokens. Cursors are opaque, error codes are stable, and public resource fields are explicit projections.

get.summary: Get a project reporting series or rollup
get.description: Requires the project:read scope. User authorization and PAT resource restrictions still apply.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Recent Sprint count or calendar-day range. Created-vs-resolved supports up to 366 days; other time series cap at 90 days.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO calendar date. Must be on or before end.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO calendar date.

parameters.name: cycleStartStatus
parameters.description: Canonical status whose first entry starts cycle time.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Epic ordering, or Ageing WIP oldest-list ordering.

parameters.name: squeakql
parameters.description: Validated SqueakQL population filter.

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Organization-member UUID, me, or none.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Project label UUID or name, or none for Work Items without labels.

parameters.name: buckets
parameters.description: Ascending comma-separated inclusive day limits for Ageing WIP, for example 3,7,14,30,60.

200.description: Bounded project report data. The selected series or rows are returned in items and data with an opaque cursor page.

bearerAuth.description: Personal Access Token sent in the Authorization header.

WorkItemSummary.description: A Work Item collection item. With fields, only id, key, and revision are guaranteed; other summary properties may be omitted.

WorkItemList.description: A Project Work Item page. When fields is supplied, id, key, and revision remain present and other summary properties may be omitted.

PublicWorkItemSummary.description: A public Work Item collection item. With fields, only id, key, and revision are guaranteed; other summary properties may be omitted.

WorkItemContextList.description: An Organization, My Work, or profile Work Item page. With fields, id, key, revision, project, and organization remain present; other summary properties may be omitted.

ProfileWorkItemList.description: A profile Work Item page. Each item includes project and Organization context; the complete projection also includes a public reporter summary. Sparse fields omit reporter because it is not a Work Item summary field. Id, key, revision, project, and organization are always present.
